parameters.name: MLDMACAddress
parameters.description: The Multi-Link Device (MLD) MAC Address of the STA MLD. {{bibref|EasyMesh}} source: Associated STA MLD Configuration Report TLV.

parameters.name: Hostname
parameters.description: The Hostname for the STA MLD.

parameters.name: IPv4Address
parameters.description: The IPv4 address allocated to the MLD MAC Address of this device.

parameters.name: IPv6Address
parameters.description: The IPv6 address allocated to the MLD MAC Address of this device.

parameters.name: IsbSTA
parameters.description: Indicates if the STA MLD is a backhaul STA MLD (bSTA MLD). This is useful to identify the type of STA MLD when the same AP MLD is used for both Fronthaul and Backhaul operation. {{bibref|EasyMesh}} source: Backhaul STA MLD Configuration TLV.

parameters.name: LastConnectTime
parameters.description: The time in {{units}} since this STA MLD was associated.

parameters.name: BytesSent
parameters.description: The total number of bytes transmitted to the STA MLD. {{bibref|EasyMesh}} source: Associated STA Traffic Stats TLV.

parameters.name: BytesReceived
parameters.description: The total number of bytes received from the STA MLD. {{bibref|EasyMesh}} source: Associated STA Traffic Stats TLV.

parameters.name: PacketsSent
parameters.description: The total number of packets transmitted to the STA MLD. {{bibref|EasyMesh}} source: Associated STA Traffic Stats TLV.

parameters.name: PacketsReceived
parameters.description: The total number of packets received from the STA MLD. {{bibref|EasyMesh}} source: Associated STA Traffic Stats TLV.

parameters.name: ErrorsSent
parameters.description: The number of packets which could not be transmitted to the STA MLD due to errors. {{bibref|EasyMesh}} source: Associated STA Traffic Stats TLV.

parameters.name: ErrorsReceived
parameters.description: The number of packets which were received with error from the STA MLD. {{bibref|EasyMesh}} source: Associated STA Traffic Stats TLV.

parameters.name: RetransCount
parameters.description: The number of packets transmitted with the retry flag sent to the STA MLD. {{bibref|EasyMesh}} source: Associated STA Traffic Stats TLV.

parameters.name: PairwiseAKM
parameters.description: Pairwise AKM suite selector selected by the STA MLD. The Pairwise AKM suite selector (OUI and type) is encoded as a 4-octet hex-encoded value without internal delimiters, e.g. 506F9A02 {{bibref|802.11-2020|Table 9-151}}.

parameters.name: PairwiseCipher
parameters.description: Pairwise AKM cipher selector selected by the STA MLD. The Pairwise AKM cipher selector (OUI and type) is encoded as a 4-octet hex-encoded value without internal delimiters, e.g. 506F9A02 {{bibref|802.11-2020|Table 9-149}}.

parameters.name: RSNCapabilities
parameters.description: The RSN Capabilities selected by the STA MLD during association {{bibref|802.11-2020|Section 9.4.2.24.4}}.

object.description: This object describes Multi-Link Operation (MLO) capable stations (STAs), also known as client Multilink Devices (MLDs), associated to this MLO capable Access Point. {{bibref|EasyMesh}} source: Associated Clients TLV.
